notes:
A compound of {進行|しんこう} (progress, advance) and {中|ちゅう} (in the middle of). Functions as a status label or modifier. Very common in business, project management, and official communications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現在|げんざい}{進行中|しんこうちゅう}: currently in progress
- {進行中|しんこうちゅう}の{案件|あんけん}: ongoing case/matter
- {進行中|しんこうちゅう}のプロジェクト: project in progress
- {病気|びょうき}が{進行中|しんこうちゅう}: disease is progressing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実施中|じっしちゅう}: being implemented — focuses on active execution
- {継続中|けいぞくちゅう}: continuing, ongoing — emphasizes that something has not stopped
- {作業中|さぎょうちゅう}: at work, in operation — specifically about physical or manual work

definitions.explanation: currently in the process of advancing or developing; not yet completed

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}は{進行中|しんこうちゅう}です。
{調査|ちょうさ}は{現在|げんざい}{進行中|しんこうちゅう}である。
{進行中|しんこうちゅう}のプロジェクトについて{報告|ほうこく}してください。
examples.english: Please report on the projects that are in progress.
